ko.title: $950억 달러 규모의 수주 잔고: AI 서버 주문이 기록을 경신하며 델(Dell)의 실적 호조를 이끌다

segments.src: ## Dell Stock Surges on Record AI Server Demand
segments.tr: ## 델(Dell) 주가, 기록적인 AI 서버 수요에 급등

segments.src: Shares of Dell Technologies jumped as much as 16% in a single trading session after the company reported quarterly results that exceeded Wall Street expectations, driven almost entirely by explosive demand for servers built to power artificial intelligence workloads.
segments.tr: 델 테크놀로지스(Dell Technologies)의 주가가 단일 거래일 동안 최대 16% 급등했다. 이는 인공지능(AI) 워크로드를 구동하기 위해 제작된 서버에 대한 폭발적인 수요가 거의 전적으로 견인한 분기 실적이 월스트리트의 예상을 뛰어넘었기 때문이다.

segments.src: The rally added billions of dollars to Dell's market value and reignited investor enthusiasm for companies sitting at the center of the AI infrastructure buildout.
segments.tr: 이번 급등으로 델의 시가총액은 수십억 달러 증가했으며, AI 인프라 구축의 중심에 있는 기업들에 대한 투자자들의 열기를 다시 불러일으켰다.

segments.src: At the heart of the announcement was a striking figure: a record $95 billion backlog of AI server orders still waiting to be fulfilled.
segments.tr: 이번 발표의 핵심은 놀라운 수치였다. 바로 아직 이행되지 않은 AI 서버 주문 잔고가 950억 달러라는 기록적인 수준이라는 점이다.

segments.src: That number represents work already booked but not yet delivered or recognized as revenue, giving investors a rare window into how much demand is queued up for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: 이 수치는 이미 계약은 완료되었으나 아직 인도되지 않았거나 매출로 인식되지 않은 물량을 의미하며, 투자자들에게 향후 몇 분기 동안 얼마나 많은 수요가 대기 중인지 보여주는 드문 기회를 제공한다.

segments.src: ## What Drove the Beat
segments.tr: ## 실적 호조의 원동력

segments.src: Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group, which houses its server and networking business, has become the company's primary growth engine over the past two years as enterprises and cloud providers race to build out AI computing capacity.
segments.tr: 서버 및 네트워킹 사업을 담당하는 델의 인프라 솔루션 그룹(Infrastructure Solutions Group)은 기업과 클라우드 제공업체들이 AI 컴퓨팅 용량을 구축하기 위해 경쟁함에 따라 지난 2년간 회사의 주요 성장 엔진이 되었다.

segments.src: Large customers — including hyperscale cloud operators and enterprise clients building private AI clusters — have been placing increasingly large orders for servers equipped with the latest generation of AI accelerator chips.
segments.tr: 하이퍼스케일 클라우드 운영업체와 자체 AI 클러스터를 구축하는 기업 고객을 포함한 대형 고객들은 최신 세대의 AI 가속기 칩을 탑재한 서버에 대해 점점 더 큰 규모의 주문을 넣고 있다.

segments.src: The scale of the backlog suggests that demand is not just holding steady but continuing to accelerate, even as the AI infrastructure buildout enters its third year.
segments.tr: 수주 잔고의 규모는 AI 인프라 구축이 3년 차에 접어들었음에도 불구하고 수요가 단순히 유지되는 것을 넘어 계속해서 가속화되고 있음을 시사한다.

segments.src: Analysts have noted that order backlogs of this size typically indicate visibility into future revenue that extends well beyond a single quarter, giving management more confidence in forward guidance.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 이 정도 규모의 수주 잔고는 일반적으로 단일 분기를 훨씬 넘어서는 미래 매출에 대한 가시성을 나타내며, 경영진이 향후 가이던스에 대해 더 큰 자신감을 갖게 한다고 지적했다.

segments.src: ## Guidance Raised for the Full Year
segments.tr: ## 연간 가이던스 상향 조정

segments.src: Following the strong results, Dell raised its full-year sales guidance to $192 billion, up from prior projections.
segments.tr: 강력한 실적에 힘입어 델은 연간 매출 가이던스를 기존 전망치보다 높은 1,920억 달러로 상향 조정했다.

segments.src: Management pointed to sustained enterprise investment in AI infrastructure, along with continued strength in traditional PC and commercial computing segments, as reasons for the more optimistic outlook.
segments.tr: 경영진은 AI 인프라에 대한 지속적인 기업 투자와 더불어 기존 PC 및 상업용 컴퓨팅 부문의 지속적인 강세를 더 낙관적인 전망의 이유로 꼽았다.

segments.src: Raising guidance after a record quarter is often read by investors as a signal of confidence that current demand trends are durable rather than a one-time spike.
segments.tr: 기록적인 분기 실적 이후 가이던스를 상향 조정하는 것은 투자자들에게 현재의 수요 추세가 일시적인 급증이 아니라 지속 가능하다는 자신감의 신호로 읽히는 경우가 많다.

segments.src: For a hardware maker like Dell, whose margins depend heavily on the mix of AI-optimized servers versus traditional computing equipment, backlog growth of this magnitude offers a degree of revenue visibility that has been rare in the hardware industry.
segments.tr: AI 최적화 서버와 기존 컴퓨팅 장비의 구성 비율에 따라 마진이 크게 좌우되는 델과 같은 하드웨어 제조사에게, 이 정도 규모의 수주 잔고 증가는 하드웨어 업계에서 보기 드문 매출 가시성을 제공한다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Debate: Is the AI Buildout Overheating?
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 논쟁: AI 구축은 과열되었는가?

segments.src: Dell's results landed in the middle of an intensifying debate on Wall Street and in Silicon Valley about whether corporate and cloud spending on AI infrastructure has become excessive.
segments.tr: 델의 실적은 기업 및 클라우드의 AI 인프라 지출이 과도해졌는지에 대한 월스트리트와 실리콘밸리의 격렬한 논쟁 한가운데서 발표되었다.

segments.src: Proponents argue that the surge in orders reflects genuine, sustained demand for computing capacity as companies deploy AI models at scale across search, enterprise software, and consumer applications.
segments.tr: 옹호론자들은 주문 급증이 기업들이 검색, 엔터프라이즈 소프트웨어, 소비자 애플리케이션 전반에 걸쳐 AI 모델을 대규모로 배포함에 따라 컴퓨팅 용량에 대한 진정하고 지속적인 수요를 반영한다고 주장한다.

segments.src: Skeptics, on the other hand, point to the enormous capital expenditure commitments being made across the technology sector and question whether returns on that investment will materialize quickly enough to justify current spending levels.
segments.tr: 반면 회의론자들은 기술 분야 전반에 걸쳐 이루어지고 있는 막대한 자본 지출 약속을 지적하며, 그러한 투자에 대한 수익이 현재의 지출 수준을 정당화할 만큼 빠르게 실현될 수 있을지 의문을 제기한다.

segments.src: Some market watchers have drawn comparisons to prior technology infrastructure cycles, where rapid buildouts were later followed by periods of digestion once supply caught up with demand.
segments.tr: 일부 시장 관찰자들은 과거의 기술 인프라 주기를 비교하며, 급격한 구축 이후 공급이 수요를 따라잡으면서 소화 기간이 뒤따랐던 사례를 언급하기도 한다.

segments.src: Dell's numbers do not resolve that debate, but they do offer fresh evidence that, for now, order volume from large buyers of AI infrastructure continues to climb rather than plateau.
segments.tr: 델의 수치는 그 논쟁을 해결해주지는 않지만, 적어도 현재로서는 AI 인프라의 대형 구매자들로부터의 주문량이 정체되지 않고 계속 증가하고 있다는 새로운 증거를 제시한다.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## 향후 의미

segments.src: For Dell, the record backlog provides a cushion of future revenue, but it also raises the bar for execution.
segments.tr: 델에게 기록적인 수주 잔고는 미래 매출의 완충 장치를 제공하지만, 동시에 실행에 대한 기준을 높이기도 한다.

segments.src: Meeting a $95 billion order pipeline requires securing enough AI accelerator chip supply, managing complex manufacturing logistics, and maintaining margins as competition among server makers intensifies.
segments.tr: 950억 달러 규모의 주문 파이프라인을 충족하려면 충분한 AI 가속기 칩 공급을 확보하고, 복잡한 제조 물류를 관리하며, 서버 제조사 간 경쟁이 심화되는 가운데 마진을 유지해야 한다.

segments.src: Investors will be watching upcoming quarters to see whether Dell can convert its backlog into delivered revenue at the pace implied by its raised guidance, and whether new orders continue to flow in at a similar clip.
segments.tr: 투자자들은 델이 상향 조정된 가이던스가 암시하는 속도로 수주 잔고를 실제 매출로 전환할 수 있는지, 그리고 새로운 주문이 비슷한 속도로 계속 유입되는지 확인하기 위해 향후 분기를 지켜볼 것이다.

segments.src: The results also serve as a broader data point for the technology sector: as long as large AI buyers keep placing orders, hardware suppliers further down the chain stand to benefit — at least until spending patterns shift.
segments.tr: 이번 실적은 기술 분야 전반에 대한 더 넓은 데이터 포인트 역할도 한다. 대형 AI 구매자들이 계속해서 주문을 넣는 한, 지출 패턴이 바뀌기 전까지는 공급망 하단의 하드웨어 공급업체들이 혜택을 볼 것이다.

zh.title: 950亿美元积压订单：戴尔AI服务器订单破纪录，季度业绩大爆发内幕

segments.src: ## Dell Stock Surges on Record AI Server Demand
segments.tr: ## 戴尔股价因AI服务器需求创纪录而飙升

segments.src: Shares of Dell Technologies jumped as much as 16% in a single trading session after the company reported quarterly results that exceeded Wall Street expectations, driven almost entirely by explosive demand for servers built to power artificial intelligence workloads.
segments.tr: 戴尔科技（Dell Technologies）的股价在单日交易中一度飙升16%，此前该公司公布的季度业绩超出了华尔街的预期，这几乎完全是由为人工智能工作负载提供动力的服务器的爆炸性需求所推动的。

segments.src: The rally added billions of dollars to Dell's market value and reignited investor enthusiasm for companies sitting at the center of the AI infrastructure buildout.
segments.tr: 此次上涨为戴尔增加了数十亿美元的市值，并重新点燃了投资者对处于AI基础设施建设核心地位的公司的热情。

segments.src: At the heart of the announcement was a striking figure: a record $95 billion backlog of AI server orders still waiting to be fulfilled.
segments.tr: 此次公告的核心是一个惊人的数字：高达950亿美元的AI服务器订单积压，等待交付。

segments.src: That number represents work already booked but not yet delivered or recognized as revenue, giving investors a rare window into how much demand is queued up for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: 这个数字代表了已经预订但尚未交付或确认为收入的工作量，为投资者提供了一个难得的窗口，让他们了解未来几个季度积压了多少需求。

segments.src: ## What Drove the Beat
segments.tr: ## 业绩超预期的驱动因素

segments.src: Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group, which houses its server and networking business, has become the company's primary growth engine over the past two years as enterprises and cloud providers race to build out AI computing capacity.
segments.tr: 戴尔的基础设施解决方案集团（Infrastructure Solutions Group）涵盖了其服务器和网络业务，在过去两年中已成为该公司主要的增长引擎，因为企业和云服务提供商竞相构建AI计算能力。

segments.src: Large customers — including hyperscale cloud operators and enterprise clients building private AI clusters — have been placing increasingly large orders for servers equipped with the latest generation of AI accelerator chips.
segments.tr: 大型客户——包括超大规模云运营商和构建私有AI集群的企业客户——一直在为配备最新一代AI加速芯片的服务器下达越来越大的订单。

segments.src: The scale of the backlog suggests that demand is not just holding steady but continuing to accelerate, even as the AI infrastructure buildout enters its third year.
segments.tr: 积压订单的规模表明，即使AI基础设施建设进入第三年，需求不仅保持稳定，而且还在继续加速。

segments.src: Analysts have noted that order backlogs of this size typically indicate visibility into future revenue that extends well beyond a single quarter, giving management more confidence in forward guidance.
segments.tr: 分析师指出，这种规模的订单积压通常意味着对未来收入的可见性远超单个季度，这使管理层对前瞻性指引更有信心。

segments.src: ## Guidance Raised for the Full Year
segments.tr: ## 上调全年业绩指引

segments.src: Following the strong results, Dell raised its full-year sales guidance to $192 billion, up from prior projections.
segments.tr: 在强劲的业绩表现之后，戴尔将其全年销售指引上调至1920亿美元，高于此前的预测。

segments.src: Management pointed to sustained enterprise investment in AI infrastructure, along with continued strength in traditional PC and commercial computing segments, as reasons for the more optimistic outlook.
segments.tr: 管理层指出，企业对AI基础设施的持续投资，加上传统PC和商业计算领域的持续强劲表现，是这一更乐观前景的原因。

segments.src: Raising guidance after a record quarter is often read by investors as a signal of confidence that current demand trends are durable rather than a one-time spike.
segments.tr: 在创纪录的季度之后上调指引，通常被投资者解读为一种信心信号，表明当前的各种需求趋势是持久的，而非一次性的激增。

segments.src: For a hardware maker like Dell, whose margins depend heavily on the mix of AI-optimized servers versus traditional computing equipment, backlog growth of this magnitude offers a degree of revenue visibility that has been rare in the hardware industry.
segments.tr: 对于像戴尔这样的硬件制造商来说，其利润率在很大程度上取决于AI优化服务器与传统计算设备的组合，如此规模的积压订单增长提供了硬件行业中罕见的收入可见性。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Debate: Is the AI Buildout Overheating?
segments.tr: ## 更大的争论：AI建设是否过热？

segments.src: Dell's results landed in the middle of an intensifying debate on Wall Street and in Silicon Valley about whether corporate and cloud spending on AI infrastructure has become excessive.
segments.tr: 戴尔的业绩公布正值华尔街和硅谷关于企业和云端在AI基础设施上的支出是否已经过度的激烈辩论之中。

segments.src: Proponents argue that the surge in orders reflects genuine, sustained demand for computing capacity as companies deploy AI models at scale across search, enterprise software, and consumer applications.
segments.tr: 支持者认为，订单的激增反映了对计算能力的真实、持续的需求，因为企业正在搜索、企业软件和消费者应用等领域大规模部署AI模型。

segments.src: Skeptics, on the other hand, point to the enormous capital expenditure commitments being made across the technology sector and question whether returns on that investment will materialize quickly enough to justify current spending levels.
segments.tr: 另一方面，怀疑论者指出整个科技行业正在进行的巨额资本支出承诺，并质疑这些投资的回报是否能足够快地实现，以证明当前的支出水平是合理的。

segments.src: Some market watchers have drawn comparisons to prior technology infrastructure cycles, where rapid buildouts were later followed by periods of digestion once supply caught up with demand.
segments.tr: 一些市场观察人士将其与之前的技术基础设施周期进行了比较，在那些周期中，快速建设之后往往会随着供应赶上需求而出现消化期。

segments.src: Dell's numbers do not resolve that debate, but they do offer fresh evidence that, for now, order volume from large buyers of AI infrastructure continues to climb rather than plateau.
segments.tr: 戴尔的数据并没有解决这一争论，但它们确实提供了新的证据，表明目前AI基础设施大买家的订单量仍在攀升，而非趋于平稳。

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## 未来意味着什么

segments.src: For Dell, the record backlog provides a cushion of future revenue, but it also raises the bar for execution.
segments.tr: 对于戴尔来说，创纪录的积压订单提供了未来收入的缓冲，但也提高了执行门槛。

segments.src: Meeting a $95 billion order pipeline requires securing enough AI accelerator chip supply, managing complex manufacturing logistics, and maintaining margins as competition among server makers intensifies.
segments.tr: 满足950亿美元的订单渠道需要确保足够的AI加速芯片供应，管理复杂的制造物流，并在服务器制造商之间的竞争加剧时保持利润率。

segments.src: Investors will be watching upcoming quarters to see whether Dell can convert its backlog into delivered revenue at the pace implied by its raised guidance, and whether new orders continue to flow in at a similar clip.
segments.tr: 投资者将密切关注未来几个季度，看看戴尔能否以其上调指引所暗示的速度将积压订单转化为已交付收入，以及新订单是否继续以同样的速度涌入。

segments.src: The results also serve as a broader data point for the technology sector: as long as large AI buyers keep placing orders, hardware suppliers further down the chain stand to benefit — at least until spending patterns shift.
segments.tr: 这些结果也为科技行业提供了一个更广泛的数据点：只要大型AI买家继续下单，产业链下游的硬件供应商就会受益——至少在支出模式发生转变之前是这样。

segments.tr: डेल टेक्नोलॉजीज के शेयरों में एक ही ट्रेडिंग सत्र में 16% तक की उछाल आई, जब कंपनी ने त्रैमासिक परिणाम रिपोर्ट किए जो वॉल स्ट्रीट की उम्मीदों से अधिक थे, जिसका मुख्य कारण आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस वर्कलोड को पावर देने के लिए बनाए गए सर्वरों की जबरदस्त मांग थी।

segments.src: The rally added billions of dollars to Dell's market value and reignited investor enthusiasm for companies sitting at the center of the AI infrastructure buildout.
segments.tr: इस रैली ने डेल के बाजार मूल्य में अरबों डॉलर जोड़ दिए और AI इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर निर्माण के केंद्र में बैठी कंपनियों के लिए निवेशकों के उत्साह को फिर से जगा दिया।

segments.src: At the heart of the announcement was a striking figure: a record $95 billion backlog of AI server orders still waiting to be fulfilled.
segments.tr: घोषणा के केंद्र में एक चौंकाने वाला आंकड़ा था: AI सर्वर ऑर्डर का $95 बिलियन का रिकॉर्ड बैकलॉग जो अभी भी पूरा होने की प्रतीक्षा में है।

segments.src: That number represents work already booked but not yet delivered or recognized as revenue, giving investors a rare window into how much demand is queued up for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: यह संख्या उस काम का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है जो पहले ही बुक किया जा चुका है लेकिन अभी तक डिलीवर नहीं किया गया है या राजस्व के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त नहीं है, जिससे निवेशकों को यह दुर्लभ जानकारी मिलती है कि आने वाली तिमाहियों के लिए कितनी मांग कतार में है।

segments.src: ## What Drove the Beat
segments.tr: ## क्या रहा सफलता का कारण

segments.src: Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group, which houses its server and networking business, has become the company's primary growth engine over the past two years as enterprises and cloud providers race to build out AI computing capacity.
segments.tr: डेल का इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर सॉल्यूशंस ग्रुप, जिसमें इसका सर्वर और नेटवर्किंग व्यवसाय शामिल है, पिछले दो वर्षों में कंपनी का प्राथमिक विकास इंजन बन गया है क्योंकि उद्यम और क्लाउड प्रदाता AI कंप्यूटिंग क्षमता बनाने की दौड़ में हैं।

segments.src: Large customers — including hyperscale cloud operators and enterprise clients building private AI clusters — have been placing increasingly large orders for servers equipped with the latest generation of AI accelerator chips.
segments.tr: बड़े ग्राहक — जिनमें हाइपरस्केल क्लाउड ऑपरेटर और निजी AI क्लस्टर बनाने वाले उद्यम ग्राहक शामिल हैं — नवीनतम पीढ़ी के AI एक्सेलेरेटर चिप्स से लैस सर्वरों के लिए तेजी से बड़े ऑर्डर दे रहे हैं।

segments.src: The scale of the backlog suggests that demand is not just holding steady but continuing to accelerate, even as the AI infrastructure buildout enters its third year.
segments.tr: बैकलॉग का पैमाना बताता है कि मांग न केवल स्थिर बनी हुई है बल्कि लगातार बढ़ रही है, भले ही AI इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर निर्माण अपने तीसरे वर्ष में प्रवेश कर रहा हो।

segments.src: Analysts have noted that order backlogs of this size typically indicate visibility into future revenue that extends well beyond a single quarter, giving management more confidence in forward guidance.
segments.tr: विश्लेषकों ने नोट किया है कि इस आकार के ऑर्डर बैकलॉग आमतौर पर भविष्य के राजस्व में दृश्यता का संकेत देते हैं जो एक तिमाही से कहीं आगे तक फैली होती है, जिससे प्रबंधन को फॉरवर्ड गाइडेंस में अधिक आत्मविश्वास मिलता है।

segments.src: ## Guidance Raised for the Full Year
segments.tr: ## पूरे वर्ष के लिए गाइडेंस बढ़ाई गई

segments.src: Following the strong results, Dell raised its full-year sales guidance to $192 billion, up from prior projections.
segments.tr: मजबूत परिणामों के बाद, डेल ने अपने पूरे वर्ष के बिक्री गाइडेंस को पिछले अनुमानों से बढ़ाकर $192 बिलियन कर दिया।

segments.src: Management pointed to sustained enterprise investment in AI infrastructure, along with continued strength in traditional PC and commercial computing segments, as reasons for the more optimistic outlook.
segments.tr: प्रबंधन ने अधिक आशावादी दृष्टिकोण के कारणों के रूप में AI इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर में निरंतर उद्यम निवेश, और पारंपरिक पीसी और वाणिज्यिक कंप्यूटिंग क्षेत्रों में निरंतर मजबूती की ओर इशारा किया।

segments.src: Raising guidance after a record quarter is often read by investors as a signal of confidence that current demand trends are durable rather than a one-time spike.
segments.tr: रिकॉर्ड तिमाही के बाद गाइडेंस बढ़ाना अक्सर निवेशकों द्वारा इस विश्वास के संकेत के रूप में पढ़ा जाता है कि वर्तमान मांग के रुझान टिकाऊ हैं, न कि एक बार की तेजी।

segments.src: For a hardware maker like Dell, whose margins depend heavily on the mix of AI-optimized servers versus traditional computing equipment, backlog growth of this magnitude offers a degree of revenue visibility that has been rare in the hardware industry.
segments.tr: डेल जैसे हार्डवेयर निर्माता के लिए, जिसका मार्जिन AI-अनुकूलित सर्वर बनाम पारंपरिक कंप्यूटिंग उपकरणों के मिश्रण पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर करता है, इस परिमाण का बैकलॉग विकास राजस्व दृश्यता की एक ऐसी डिग्री प्रदान करता है जो हार्डवेयर उद्योग में दुर्लभ रही है।

segments.src: ## The Bigger Debate: Is the AI Buildout Overheating?
segments.tr: ## बड़ी बहस: क्या AI निर्माण ओवरहीट हो रहा है?

segments.src: Dell's results landed in the middle of an intensifying debate on Wall Street and in Silicon Valley about whether corporate and cloud spending on AI infrastructure has become excessive.
segments.tr: डेल के परिणाम वॉल स्ट्रीट और सिलिकॉन वैली में चल रही उस गहन बहस के बीच आए हैं कि क्या AI इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर पर कॉर्पोरेट और क्लाउड खर्च अत्यधिक हो गया है।

segments.src: Proponents argue that the surge in orders reflects genuine, sustained demand for computing capacity as companies deploy AI models at scale across search, enterprise software, and consumer applications.
segments.tr: समर्थकों का तर्क है कि ऑर्डर में उछाल कंप्यूटिंग क्षमता के लिए वास्तविक, निरंतर मांग को दर्शाता है क्योंकि कंपनियां खोज, उद्यम सॉफ्टवेयर और उपभोक्ता अनुप्रयोगों में बड़े पैमाने पर AI मॉडल तैनात कर रही हैं।

segments.src: Skeptics, on the other hand, point to the enormous capital expenditure commitments being made across the technology sector and question whether returns on that investment will materialize quickly enough to justify current spending levels.
segments.tr: दूसरी ओर, संशयवादी पूरे प्रौद्योगिकी क्षेत्र में की जा रही भारी पूंजीगत व्यय प्रतिबद्धताओं की ओर इशारा करते हैं और सवाल करते हैं कि क्या उस निवेश पर रिटर्न वर्तमान खर्च के स्तर को सही ठहराने के लिए पर्याप्त तेजी से प्राप्त होगा।

segments.src: Some market watchers have drawn comparisons to prior technology infrastructure cycles, where rapid buildouts were later followed by periods of digestion once supply caught up with demand.
segments.tr: कुछ बाजार नजर रखने वालों ने पिछले प्रौद्योगिकी इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर चक्रों से तुलना की है, जहां तेजी से निर्माण के बाद आपूर्ति के मांग के बराबर होने पर पाचन की अवधि आती है।

segments.src: Dell's numbers do not resolve that debate, but they do offer fresh evidence that, for now, order volume from large buyers of AI infrastructure continues to climb rather than plateau.
segments.tr: डेल के आंकड़े उस बहस को हल नहीं करते हैं, लेकिन वे ताजा सबूत देते हैं कि, अभी के लिए, AI इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर के बड़े खरीदारों से ऑर्डर की मात्रा स्थिर होने के बजाय लगातार बढ़ रही है।

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## आगे इसका क्या मतलब है

segments.src: For Dell, the record backlog provides a cushion of future revenue, but it also raises the bar for execution.
segments.tr: डेल के लिए, रिकॉर्ड बैकलॉग भविष्य के राजस्व का एक कुशन प्रदान करता है, लेकिन यह निष्पादन के लिए बार भी बढ़ाता है।

segments.src: Meeting a $95 billion order pipeline requires securing enough AI accelerator chip supply, managing complex manufacturing logistics, and maintaining margins as competition among server makers intensifies.
segments.tr: 95 बिलियन डॉलर की ऑर्डर पाइपलाइन को पूरा करने के लिए पर्याप्त AI एक्सेलेरेटर चिप आपूर्ति सुरक्षित करने, जटिल विनिर्माण लॉजिस्टिक्स का प्रबंधन करने और सर्वर निर्माताओं के बीच प्रतिस्पर्धा बढ़ने के साथ मार्जिन बनाए रखने की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: Investors will be watching upcoming quarters to see whether Dell can convert its backlog into delivered revenue at the pace implied by its raised guidance, and whether new orders continue to flow in at a similar clip.
segments.tr: निवेशक आगामी तिमाहियों पर नजर रखेंगे कि क्या डेल अपने बैकलॉग को अपने बढ़े हुए गाइडेंस द्वारा निहित गति से वितरित राजस्व में बदल सकता है, और क्या नए ऑर्डर इसी गति से आते रहेंगे।

segments.src: The results also serve as a broader data point for the technology sector: as long as large AI buyers keep placing orders, hardware suppliers further down the chain stand to benefit — at least until spending patterns shift.
segments.tr: परिणाम प्रौद्योगिकी क्षेत्र के लिए एक व्यापक डेटा बिंदु के रूप में भी काम करते हैं: जब तक बड़े AI खरीदार ऑर्डर देना जारी रखते हैं, तब तक श्रृंखला में नीचे के हार्डवेयर आपूर्तिकर्ताओं को लाभ होगा — कम से कम तब तक जब तक खर्च के पैटर्न में बदलाव नहीं आता।

es.title: $95 mil millones en pedidos pendientes: Análisis del trimestre récord de Dell mientras los pedidos de servidores de IA baten récords

segments.src: ## Dell Stock Surges on Record AI Server Demand
segments.tr: ## Las acciones de Dell se disparan ante la demanda récord de servidores de IA

segments.src: Shares of Dell Technologies jumped as much as 16% in a single trading session after the company reported quarterly results that exceeded Wall Street expectations, driven almost entirely by explosive demand for servers built to power artificial intelligence workloads.
segments.tr: Las acciones de Dell Technologies subieron hasta un 16% en una sola sesión bursátil después de que la empresa reportara resultados trimestrales que superaron las expectativas de Wall Street, impulsados casi en su totalidad por la demanda explosiva de servidores diseñados para potenciar cargas de trabajo de inteligencia artificial.

segments.src: The rally added billions of dollars to Dell's market value and reignited investor enthusiasm for companies sitting at the center of the AI infrastructure buildout.
segments.tr: El repunte añadió miles de millones de dólares al valor de mercado de Dell y reavivó el entusiasmo de los inversores por las empresas situadas en el centro del desarrollo de la infraestructura de IA.

segments.src: At the heart of the announcement was a striking figure: a record $95 billion backlog of AI server orders still waiting to be fulfilled.
segments.tr: En el centro del anuncio hubo una cifra sorprendente: una cartera de pedidos pendientes de servidores de IA récord de $95 mil millones que aún esperan ser cumplidos.

segments.src: That number represents work already booked but not yet delivered or recognized as revenue, giving investors a rare window into how much demand is queued up for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: Ese número representa trabajo ya contratado pero aún no entregado ni reconocido como ingresos, lo que brinda a los inversores una ventana poco común sobre cuánta demanda hay acumulada para los próximos trimestres.

segments.src: ## What Drove the Beat
segments.tr: ## Qué impulsó los resultados

segments.src: Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group, which houses its server and networking business, has become the company's primary growth engine over the past two years as enterprises and cloud providers race to build out AI computing capacity.
segments.tr: El Infrastructure Solutions Group de Dell, que alberga su negocio de servidores y redes, se ha convertido en el principal motor de crecimiento de la empresa en los últimos dos años, a medida que las empresas y los proveedores de la nube compiten por construir capacidad de computación de IA.

segments.src: Large customers — including hyperscale cloud operators and enterprise clients building private AI clusters — have been placing increasingly large orders for servers equipped with the latest generation of AI accelerator chips.
segments.tr: Los grandes clientes —incluidos los operadores de nube a hiperescala y los clientes empresariales que construyen clústeres de IA privados— han estado realizando pedidos cada vez mayores de servidores equipados con la última generación de chips aceleradores de IA.

segments.src: The scale of the backlog suggests that demand is not just holding steady but continuing to accelerate, even as the AI infrastructure buildout enters its third year.
segments.tr: La escala de la cartera de pedidos sugiere que la demanda no solo se mantiene estable, sino que continúa acelerándose, incluso cuando el desarrollo de la infraestructura de IA entra en su tercer año.

segments.src: Analysts have noted that order backlogs of this size typically indicate visibility into future revenue that extends well beyond a single quarter, giving management more confidence in forward guidance.
segments.tr: Los analistas han señalado que las carteras de pedidos de este tamaño suelen indicar una visibilidad de los ingresos futuros que se extiende mucho más allá de un solo trimestre, lo que da a la dirección más confianza en las proyecciones futuras.

segments.src: ## Guidance Raised for the Full Year
segments.tr: ## Proyecciones elevadas para todo el año

segments.src: Following the strong results, Dell raised its full-year sales guidance to $192 billion, up from prior projections.
segments.tr: Tras los sólidos resultados, Dell elevó su proyección de ventas para todo el año a $192 mil millones, por encima de las proyecciones anteriores.

segments.src: Management pointed to sustained enterprise investment in AI infrastructure, along with continued strength in traditional PC and commercial computing segments, as reasons for the more optimistic outlook.
segments.tr: La dirección señaló la inversión empresarial sostenida en infraestructura de IA, junto con la fortaleza continua en los segmentos tradicionales de PC y computación comercial, como razones para la perspectiva más optimista.

segments.src: Raising guidance after a record quarter is often read by investors as a signal of confidence that current demand trends are durable rather than a one-time spike.
segments.tr: Elevar las proyecciones después de un trimestre récord suele ser interpretado por los inversores como una señal de confianza de que las tendencias actuales de demanda son duraderas y no un pico único.

segments.src: For a hardware maker like Dell, whose margins depend heavily on the mix of AI-optimized servers versus traditional computing equipment, backlog growth of this magnitude offers a degree of revenue visibility that has been rare in the hardware industry.
segments.tr: Para un fabricante de hardware como Dell, cuyos márgenes dependen en gran medida de la combinación de servidores optimizados para IA frente a equipos informáticos tradicionales, el crecimiento de la cartera de pedidos de esta magnitud ofrece un grado de visibilidad de ingresos que ha sido poco común en la industria del hardware.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Debate: Is the AI Buildout Overheating?
segments.tr: ## El debate más amplio: ¿Se está sobrecalentando el desarrollo de la IA?

segments.src: Dell's results landed in the middle of an intensifying debate on Wall Street and in Silicon Valley about whether corporate and cloud spending on AI infrastructure has become excessive.
segments.tr: Los resultados de Dell llegaron en medio de un intenso debate en Wall Street y Silicon Valley sobre si el gasto corporativo y en la nube en infraestructura de IA se ha vuelto excesivo.

segments.src: Proponents argue that the surge in orders reflects genuine, sustained demand for computing capacity as companies deploy AI models at scale across search, enterprise software, and consumer applications.
segments.tr: Los defensores argumentan que el aumento en los pedidos refleja una demanda genuina y sostenida de capacidad de computación a medida que las empresas despliegan modelos de IA a gran escala en búsquedas, software empresarial y aplicaciones de consumo.

segments.src: Skeptics, on the other hand, point to the enormous capital expenditure commitments being made across the technology sector and question whether returns on that investment will materialize quickly enough to justify current spending levels.
segments.tr: Los escépticos, por otro lado, señalan los enormes compromisos de gasto de capital que se están realizando en todo el sector tecnológico y cuestionan si el retorno de esa inversión se materializará lo suficientemente rápido como para justificar los niveles de gasto actuales.

segments.src: Some market watchers have drawn comparisons to prior technology infrastructure cycles, where rapid buildouts were later followed by periods of digestion once supply caught up with demand.
segments.tr: Algunos observadores del mercado han hecho comparaciones con ciclos anteriores de infraestructura tecnológica, donde los rápidos desarrollos fueron seguidos posteriormente por períodos de digestión una vez que la oferta alcanzó a la demanda.

segments.src: Dell's numbers do not resolve that debate, but they do offer fresh evidence that, for now, order volume from large buyers of AI infrastructure continues to climb rather than plateau.
segments.tr: Los números de Dell no resuelven ese debate, pero ofrecen nueva evidencia de que, por ahora, el volumen de pedidos de los grandes compradores de infraestructura de IA continúa aumentando en lugar de estancarse.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## Qué significa esto de cara al futuro

segments.src: For Dell, the record backlog provides a cushion of future revenue, but it also raises the bar for execution.
segments.tr: Para Dell, la cartera de pedidos récord proporciona un colchón de ingresos futuros, pero también eleva el listón para la ejecución.

segments.src: Meeting a $95 billion order pipeline requires securing enough AI accelerator chip supply, managing complex manufacturing logistics, and maintaining margins as competition among server makers intensifies.
segments.tr: Cumplir con una cartera de pedidos de $95 mil millones requiere asegurar suficiente suministro de chips aceleradores de IA, gestionar una logística de fabricación compleja y mantener los márgenes a medida que se intensifica la competencia entre los fabricantes de servidores.

segments.src: Investors will be watching upcoming quarters to see whether Dell can convert its backlog into delivered revenue at the pace implied by its raised guidance, and whether new orders continue to flow in at a similar clip.
segments.tr: Los inversores estarán atentos a los próximos trimestres para ver si Dell puede convertir su cartera de pedidos en ingresos entregados al ritmo implícito en sus proyecciones elevadas, y si los nuevos pedidos continúan llegando a un ritmo similar.

segments.src: The results also serve as a broader data point for the technology sector: as long as large AI buyers keep placing orders, hardware suppliers further down the chain stand to benefit — at least until spending patterns shift.
segments.tr: Los resultados también sirven como un punto de datos más amplio para el sector tecnológico: mientras los grandes compradores de IA sigan realizando pedidos, los proveedores de hardware más abajo en la cadena se beneficiarán, al menos hasta que los patrones de gasto cambien.

ar.title: تراكم طلبات بقيمة 95 مليار دولار: نظرة داخل ربع ديل المذهل مع تحطيم طلبات خوادم الذكاء الاصطناعي للأرقام القياسية

segments.src: ## Dell Stock Surges on Record AI Server Demand
segments.tr: ## أسهم ديل ترتفع بفضل الطلب القياسي على خوادم الذكاء الاصطناعي

segments.src: Shares of Dell Technologies jumped as much as 16% in a single trading session after the company reported quarterly results that exceeded Wall Street expectations, driven almost entirely by explosive demand for servers built to power artificial intelligence workloads.
segments.tr: قفزت أسهم شركة ديل تكنولوجيز بنسبة تصل إلى 16% في جلسة تداول واحدة بعد أن أعلنت الشركة عن نتائج ربع سنوية تجاوزت توقعات وول ستريت، مدفوعة بالكامل تقريبًا بالطلب المتفجر على الخوادم المصممة لتشغيل أعباء عمل الذكاء الاصطناعي.

segments.src: The rally added billions of dollars to Dell's market value and reignited investor enthusiasm for companies sitting at the center of the AI infrastructure buildout.
segments.tr: وقد أضاف هذا الصعود مليارات الدولارات إلى القيمة السوقية لشركة ديل وأعاد إشعال حماس المستثمرين تجاه الشركات التي تقع في قلب عملية بناء البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي.

segments.src: At the heart of the announcement was a striking figure: a record $95 billion backlog of AI server orders still waiting to be fulfilled.
segments.tr: وكان في قلب هذا الإعلان رقم مذهل: تراكم قياسي لطلبات خوادم الذكاء الاصطناعي بقيمة 95 مليار دولار لا تزال قيد الانتظار لتلبيتها.

segments.src: That number represents work already booked but not yet delivered or recognized as revenue, giving investors a rare window into how much demand is queued up for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: ويمثل هذا الرقم أعمالاً تم حجزها بالفعل ولكن لم يتم تسليمها أو الاعتراف بها كإيرادات بعد، مما يمنح المستثمرين نافذة نادرة لمعرفة حجم الطلب المتراكم للفصول القادمة.

segments.src: ## What Drove the Beat
segments.tr: ## ما الذي دفع إلى هذا التفوق

segments.src: Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group, which houses its server and networking business, has become the company's primary growth engine over the past two years as enterprises and cloud providers race to build out AI computing capacity.
segments.tr: أصبحت مجموعة حلول البنية التحتية التابعة لشركة ديل، والتي تضم أعمال الخوادم والشبكات، محرك النمو الرئيسي للشركة على مدار العامين الماضيين مع تسابق المؤسسات ومزودي الخدمات السحابية لبناء قدرات الحوسبة للذكاء الاصطناعي.

segments.src: Large customers — including hyperscale cloud operators and enterprise clients building private AI clusters — have been placing increasingly large orders for servers equipped with the latest generation of AI accelerator chips.
segments.tr: وقد قام العملاء الكبار — بما في ذلك مشغلو السحابة فائقة النطاق وعملاء المؤسسات الذين يبنون مجموعات ذكاء اصطناعي خاصة — بتقديم طلبات متزايدة الحجم للحصول على خوادم مجهزة بأحدث جيل من رقاقات تسريع الذكاء الاصطناعي.

segments.src: The scale of the backlog suggests that demand is not just holding steady but continuing to accelerate, even as the AI infrastructure buildout enters its third year.
segments.tr: ويشير حجم الطلبات المتراكمة إلى أن الطلب لا يحافظ على استقراره فحسب، بل يستمر في التسارع، حتى مع دخول بناء البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي عامه الثالث.

segments.src: Analysts have noted that order backlogs of this size typically indicate visibility into future revenue that extends well beyond a single quarter, giving management more confidence in forward guidance.
segments.tr: وقد أشار المحللون إلى أن تراكم الطلبات بهذا الحجم يشير عادةً إلى وضوح الرؤية بشأن الإيرادات المستقبلية التي تمتد إلى ما هو أبعد من ربع سنوي واحد، مما يمنح الإدارة ثقة أكبر في التوجيهات المستقبلية.

segments.src: ## Guidance Raised for the Full Year
segments.tr: ## رفع التوقعات للعام بأكمله

segments.src: Following the strong results, Dell raised its full-year sales guidance to $192 billion, up from prior projections.
segments.tr: عقب هذه النتائج القوية، رفعت ديل توقعاتها للمبيعات للعام بأكمله إلى 192 مليار دولار، مقارنة بالتوقعات السابقة.

segments.src: Management pointed to sustained enterprise investment in AI infrastructure, along with continued strength in traditional PC and commercial computing segments, as reasons for the more optimistic outlook.
segments.tr: وأشارت الإدارة إلى استمرار استثمار المؤسسات في البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي، إلى جانب القوة المستمرة في قطاعات الكمبيوتر الشخصي التقليدي والحوسبة التجارية، كأسباب لهذه النظرة الأكثر تفاؤلاً.

segments.src: Raising guidance after a record quarter is often read by investors as a signal of confidence that current demand trends are durable rather than a one-time spike.
segments.tr: وغالباً ما يقرأ المستثمرون رفع التوقعات بعد ربع سنوي قياسي كإشارة ثقة بأن اتجاهات الطلب الحالية مستدامة وليست مجرد طفرة لمرة واحدة.

segments.src: For a hardware maker like Dell, whose margins depend heavily on the mix of AI-optimized servers versus traditional computing equipment, backlog growth of this magnitude offers a degree of revenue visibility that has been rare in the hardware industry.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لشركة تصنيع أجهزة مثل ديل، والتي تعتمد هوامش ربحها بشكل كبير على مزيج الخوادم المحسنة للذكاء الاصطناعي مقارنة بمعدات الحوسبة التقليدية، فإن نمو الطلبات المتراكمة بهذا الحجم يوفر درجة من وضوح الرؤية للإيرادات كانت نادرة في صناعة الأجهزة.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Debate: Is the AI Buildout Overheating?
segments.tr: ## النقاش الأكبر: هل يشهد بناء الذكاء الاصطناعي تضخماً مفرطاً؟

segments.src: Dell's results landed in the middle of an intensifying debate on Wall Street and in Silicon Valley about whether corporate and cloud spending on AI infrastructure has become excessive.
segments.tr: جاءت نتائج ديل في خضم نقاش محتدم في وول ستريت ووادي السيليكون حول ما إذا كان إنفاق الشركات والخدمات السحابية على البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي قد أصبح مفرطاً.

segments.src: Proponents argue that the surge in orders reflects genuine, sustained demand for computing capacity as companies deploy AI models at scale across search, enterprise software, and consumer applications.
segments.tr: ويجادل المؤيدون بأن الطفرة في الطلبات تعكس طلباً حقيقياً ومستداماً على قدرات الحوسبة مع قيام الشركات بنشر نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي على نطاق واسع عبر محركات البحث، وبرمجيات المؤسسات، وتطبيقات المستهلكين.

segments.src: Skeptics, on the other hand, point to the enormous capital expenditure commitments being made across the technology sector and question whether returns on that investment will materialize quickly enough to justify current spending levels.
segments.tr: ومن ناحية أخرى، يشير المتشككون إلى التزامات الإنفاق الرأسمالي الهائلة التي يتم تقديمها عبر قطاع التكنولوجيا ويتساءلون عما إذا كانت العوائد على هذا الاستثمار ستتحقق بالسرعة الكافية لتبرير مستويات الإنفاق الحالية.

segments.src: Some market watchers have drawn comparisons to prior technology infrastructure cycles, where rapid buildouts were later followed by periods of digestion once supply caught up with demand.
segments.tr: وقد أجرى بعض مراقبي السوق مقارنات مع دورات البنية التحتية التكنولوجية السابقة، حيث أعقب عمليات البناء السريعة فترات من الاستيعاب بمجرد أن لحق العرض بالطلب.

segments.src: Dell's numbers do not resolve that debate, but they do offer fresh evidence that, for now, order volume from large buyers of AI infrastructure continues to climb rather than plateau.
segments.tr: لا تحسم أرقام ديل هذا النقاش، لكنها تقدم دليلاً جديداً على أن حجم الطلبات من كبار مشتري البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي يستمر في الصعود بدلاً من الاستقرار في الوقت الحالي.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني ذلك للمستقبل

segments.src: For Dell, the record backlog provides a cushion of future revenue, but it also raises the bar for execution.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لشركة ديل، يوفر تراكم الطلبات القياسي وسادة للإيرادات المستقبلية، ولكنه يرفع أيضاً من سقف متطلبات التنفيذ.

segments.src: Meeting a $95 billion order pipeline requires securing enough AI accelerator chip supply, managing complex manufacturing logistics, and maintaining margins as competition among server makers intensifies.
segments.tr: إن تلبية سلسلة طلبات بقيمة 95 مليار دولار تتطلب تأمين إمدادات كافية من رقاقات تسريع الذكاء الاصطناعي، وإدارة الخدمات اللوجستية المعقدة للتصنيع، والحفاظ على هوامش الربح مع اشتداد المنافسة بين صانعي الخوادم.

segments.src: Investors will be watching upcoming quarters to see whether Dell can convert its backlog into delivered revenue at the pace implied by its raised guidance, and whether new orders continue to flow in at a similar clip.
segments.tr: وسيراقب المستثمرون الفصول القادمة لمعرفة ما إذا كان بإمكان ديل تحويل طلباتها المتراكمة إلى إيرادات مسلّمة بالوتيرة التي تقتضيها توقعاتها المرفوعة، وما إذا كانت الطلبات الجديدة ستستمر في التدفق بمعدل مماثل.

segments.src: The results also serve as a broader data point for the technology sector: as long as large AI buyers keep placing orders, hardware suppliers further down the chain stand to benefit — at least until spending patterns shift.
segments.tr: وتعمل النتائج أيضاً كمؤشر أوسع لقطاع التكنولوجيا: طالما استمر كبار مشتري الذكاء الاصطناعي في تقديم الطلبات، فإن موردي الأجهزة في أسفل السلسلة سيستفيدون — على الأقل حتى تتغير أنماط الإنفاق.

fr.title: Carnet de commandes de 95 milliards de dollars : Immersion dans le trimestre record de Dell alors que les commandes de serveurs IA battent des records

segments.src: ## Dell Stock Surges on Record AI Server Demand
segments.tr: ## L'action Dell s'envole grâce à une demande record de serveurs IA

segments.src: Shares of Dell Technologies jumped as much as 16% in a single trading session after the company reported quarterly results that exceeded Wall Street expectations, driven almost entirely by explosive demand for servers built to power artificial intelligence workloads.
segments.tr: Les actions de Dell Technologies ont bondi de jusqu'à 16 % au cours d'une seule séance de bourse après que l'entreprise a publié des résultats trimestriels dépassant les attentes de Wall Street, stimulés presque entièrement par une demande explosive de serveurs conçus pour alimenter les charges de travail en intelligence artificielle.

segments.src: The rally added billions of dollars to Dell's market value and reignited investor enthusiasm for companies sitting at the center of the AI infrastructure buildout.
segments.tr: Cette hausse a ajouté des milliards de dollars à la valeur boursière de Dell et a ravivé l'enthousiasme des investisseurs pour les entreprises situées au cœur du développement de l'infrastructure IA.

segments.src: At the heart of the announcement was a striking figure: a record $95 billion backlog of AI server orders still waiting to be fulfilled.
segments.tr: Au cœur de cette annonce se trouvait un chiffre marquant : un carnet de commandes record de 95 milliards de dollars en serveurs IA attendant encore d'être exécutées.

segments.src: That number represents work already booked but not yet delivered or recognized as revenue, giving investors a rare window into how much demand is queued up for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: Ce chiffre représente des travaux déjà réservés mais pas encore livrés ni comptabilisés comme du chiffre d'affaires, offrant aux investisseurs une fenêtre rare sur le volume de demande en attente pour les trimestriels à venir.

segments.src: ## What Drove the Beat
segments.tr: ## Ce qui a stimulé les résultats

segments.src: Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group, which houses its server and networking business, has become the company's primary growth engine over the past two years as enterprises and cloud providers race to build out AI computing capacity.
segments.tr: Le groupe Infrastructure Solutions de Dell, qui abrite son activité de serveurs et de réseaux, est devenu le principal moteur de croissance de l'entreprise au cours des deux dernières années, alors que les entreprises et les fournisseurs de cloud se précipitent pour développer leur capacité de calcul en IA.

segments.src: Large customers — including hyperscale cloud operators and enterprise clients building private AI clusters — have been placing increasingly large orders for servers equipped with the latest generation of AI accelerator chips.
segments.tr: Les grands clients — y compris les opérateurs de cloud hyperscale et les clients professionnels construisant des clusters IA privés — passent des commandes de plus en plus importantes pour des serveurs équipés de la dernière génération de puces accélératrices d'IA.

segments.src: The scale of the backlog suggests that demand is not just holding steady but continuing to accelerate, even as the AI infrastructure buildout enters its third year.
segments.tr: L'ampleur du carnet de commandes suggère que la demande ne se maintient pas seulement, mais continue de s'accélérer, alors même que le développement de l'infrastructure IA entre dans sa troisième année.

segments.src: Analysts have noted that order backlogs of this size typically indicate visibility into future revenue that extends well beyond a single quarter, giving management more confidence in forward guidance.
segments.tr: Les analystes ont noté que des carnets de commandes de cette taille indiquent généralement une visibilité sur les revenus futurs qui s'étend bien au-delà d'un seul trimestre, donnant à la direction plus de confiance dans ses prévisions.

segments.src: ## Guidance Raised for the Full Year
segments.tr: ## Prévisions revues à la hausse pour l'ensemble de l'année

segments.src: Following the strong results, Dell raised its full-year sales guidance to $192 billion, up from prior projections.
segments.tr: À la suite de ces solides résultats, Dell a relevé ses prévisions de ventes pour l'ensemble de l'année à 192 milliards de dollars, en hausse par rapport aux projections précédentes.

segments.src: Management pointed to sustained enterprise investment in AI infrastructure, along with continued strength in traditional PC and commercial computing segments, as reasons for the more optimistic outlook.
segments.tr: La direction a invoqué l'investissement soutenu des entreprises dans l'infrastructure IA, ainsi que la solidité continue des segments traditionnels des PC et de l'informatique commerciale, comme raisons de cet optimisme renouvelé.

segments.src: Raising guidance after a record quarter is often read by investors as a signal of confidence that current demand trends are durable rather than a one-time spike.
segments.tr: Relever ses prévisions après un trimestre record est souvent interprété par les investisseurs comme un signal de confiance indiquant que les tendances actuelles de la demande sont durables plutôt qu'un pic ponctuel.

segments.src: For a hardware maker like Dell, whose margins depend heavily on the mix of AI-optimized servers versus traditional computing equipment, backlog growth of this magnitude offers a degree of revenue visibility that has been rare in the hardware industry.
segments.tr: Pour un fabricant de matériel comme Dell, dont les marges dépendent fortement de la composition entre serveurs optimisés pour l'IA et équipements informatiques traditionnels, une croissance du carnet de commandes de cette ampleur offre un degré de visibilité sur les revenus qui a été rare dans l'industrie du matériel.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Debate: Is the AI Buildout Overheating?
segments.tr: ## Le grand débat : Le développement de l'IA est-il en train de surchauffer ?

segments.src: Dell's results landed in the middle of an intensifying debate on Wall Street and in Silicon Valley about whether corporate and cloud spending on AI infrastructure has become excessive.
segments.tr: Les résultats de Dell sont arrivés au milieu d'un débat intense à Wall Street et dans la Silicon Valley sur la question de savoir si les dépenses des entreprises et du cloud en infrastructure IA sont devenues excessives.

segments.src: Proponents argue that the surge in orders reflects genuine, sustained demand for computing capacity as companies deploy AI models at scale across search, enterprise software, and consumer applications.
segments.tr: Les partisans soutiennent que la flambée des commandes reflète une demande authentique et soutenue de capacité de calcul à mesure que les entreprises déploient des modèles d'IA à grande échelle dans la recherche, les logiciels d'entreprise et les applications grand public.

segments.src: Skeptics, on the other hand, point to the enormous capital expenditure commitments being made across the technology sector and question whether returns on that investment will materialize quickly enough to justify current spending levels.
segments.tr: Les sceptiques, en revanche, soulignent les énormes engagements en matière de dépenses d'investissement pris dans l'ensemble du secteur technologique et se demandent si le retour sur investissement se concrétisera assez rapidement pour justifier les niveaux de dépenses actuels.

segments.src: Some market watchers have drawn comparisons to prior technology infrastructure cycles, where rapid buildouts were later followed by periods of digestion once supply caught up with demand.
segments.tr: Certains observateurs du marché ont établi des comparaisons avec les cycles d'infrastructure technologique antérieurs, où des déploiements rapides ont ensuite été suivis de périodes de digestion une fois que l'offre a rattrapé la demande.

segments.src: Dell's numbers do not resolve that debate, but they do offer fresh evidence that, for now, order volume from large buyers of AI infrastructure continues to climb rather than plateau.
segments.tr: Les chiffres de Dell ne résolvent pas ce débat, mais ils offrent de nouvelles preuves que, pour l'instant, le volume de commandes des grands acheteurs d'infrastructure IA continue de grimper plutôt que de stagner.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour l'avenir

segments.src: For Dell, the record backlog provides a cushion of future revenue, but it also raises the bar for execution.
segments.tr: Pour Dell, le carnet de commandes record offre un coussin de revenus futurs, mais il place également la barre plus haut en matière d'exécution.

segments.src: Meeting a $95 billion order pipeline requires securing enough AI accelerator chip supply, managing complex manufacturing logistics, and maintaining margins as competition among server makers intensifies.
segments.tr: Atteindre un pipeline de commandes de 95 milliards de dollars nécessite de s'approvisionner suffisamment en puces accélératrices d'IA, de gérer une logistique de fabrication complexe et de maintenir les marges alors que la concurrence entre fabricants de serveurs s'intensifie.

segments.src: Investors will be watching upcoming quarters to see whether Dell can convert its backlog into delivered revenue at the pace implied by its raised guidance, and whether new orders continue to flow in at a similar clip.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs surveilleront les trimestriers à venir pour voir si Dell peut convertir son carnet de commandes en revenus livrés au rythme impliqué par ses prévisions revues à la hausse, et si de nouvelles commandes continuent d'arriver à un rythme similaire.

segments.src: The results also serve as a broader data point for the technology sector: as long as large AI buyers keep placing orders, hardware suppliers further down the chain stand to benefit — at least until spending patterns shift.
segments.tr: Ces résultats servent également de point de repère plus large pour le secteur technologique : tant que les grands acheteurs d'IA continueront de passer des commandes, les fournisseurs de matériel plus loin dans la chaîne en tireront des bénéfices — du moins jusqu'à ce que les habitudes de dépenses changent.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Debate: Is the AI Buildout Overheating?

segments.src: Skeptics, on the other hand, point to the enormous capital expenditure commitments being made across the technology sector and question whether returns on that investment will materialize quickly enough to justify current spending levels.

in.title: Backlog $95 Miliar: Mengintip Kuartal Luar Biasa Dell Saat Pesanan Server AI Memecahkan Rekor

segments.src: ## Dell Stock Surges on Record AI Server Demand
segments.tr: ## Saham Dell Melonjak Berkat Permintaan Server AI yang Memecahkan Rekor

segments.src: Shares of Dell Technologies jumped as much as 16% in a single trading session after the company reported quarterly results that exceeded Wall Street expectations, driven almost entirely by explosive demand for servers built to power artificial intelligence workloads.
segments.tr: Saham Dell Technologies melonjak hingga 16% dalam satu sesi perdagangan setelah perusahaan melaporkan hasil kuartalan yang melampaui ekspektasi Wall Street, yang hampir seluruhnya didorong oleh permintaan eksplosif untuk server yang dibangun guna mendukung beban kerja kecerdasan buatan (AI).

segments.src: The rally added billions of dollars to Dell's market value and reignited investor enthusiasm for companies sitting at the center of the AI infrastructure buildout.
segments.tr: Reli ini menambah nilai pasar Dell sebesar miliaran dolar dan menyalakan kembali antusiasme investor terhadap perusahaan-perusahaan yang berada di pusat pembangunan infrastruktur AI.

segments.src: At the heart of the announcement was a striking figure: a record $95 billion backlog of AI server orders still waiting to be fulfilled.
segments.tr: Inti dari pengumuman tersebut adalah angka yang mencolok: rekor backlog pesanan server AI senilai $95 miliar yang masih menunggu untuk dipenuhi.

segments.src: That number represents work already booked but not yet delivered or recognized as revenue, giving investors a rare window into how much demand is queued up for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: Angka tersebut mewakili pekerjaan yang sudah dipesan tetapi belum dikirim atau diakui sebagai pendapatan, memberikan investor pandangan langka tentang seberapa besar permintaan yang mengantre untuk kuartal-kuartal mendatang.

segments.src: ## What Drove the Beat
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Mendorong Pencapaian Ini

segments.src: Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group, which houses its server and networking business, has become the company's primary growth engine over the past two years as enterprises and cloud providers race to build out AI computing capacity.
segments.tr: Infrastructure Solutions Group milik Dell, yang menaungi bisnis server dan jaringannya, telah menjadi mesin pertumbuhan utama perusahaan selama dua tahun terakhir seiring dengan perlombaan perusahaan dan penyedia cloud untuk membangun kapasitas komputasi AI.

segments.src: Large customers — including hyperscale cloud operators and enterprise clients building private AI clusters — have been placing increasingly large orders for servers equipped with the latest generation of AI accelerator chips.
segments.tr: Pelanggan besar — termasuk operator cloud hyperscale dan klien perusahaan yang membangun klaster AI pribadi — telah menempatkan pesanan yang semakin besar untuk server yang dilengkapi dengan chip akselerator AI generasi terbaru.

segments.src: The scale of the backlog suggests that demand is not just holding steady but continuing to accelerate, even as the AI infrastructure buildout enters its third year.
segments.tr: Skala backlog menunjukkan bahwa permintaan tidak hanya stabil tetapi terus meningkat, bahkan saat pembangunan infrastruktur AI memasuki tahun ketiganya.

segments.src: Analysts have noted that order backlogs of this size typically indicate visibility into future revenue that extends well beyond a single quarter, giving management more confidence in forward guidance.
segments.tr: Para analis mencatat bahwa backlog pesanan sebesar ini biasanya menunjukkan visibilitas terhadap pendapatan masa depan yang melampaui satu kuartal, sehingga memberikan manajemen kepercayaan diri lebih besar dalam panduan ke depan.

segments.src: ## Guidance Raised for the Full Year
segments.tr: ## Panduan Ditingkatkan untuk Setahun Penuh

segments.src: Following the strong results, Dell raised its full-year sales guidance to $192 billion, up from prior projections.
segments.tr: Menyusul hasil yang kuat, Dell meningkatkan panduan penjualan setahun penuhnya menjadi $192 miliar, naik dari proyeksi sebelumnya.

segments.src: Management pointed to sustained enterprise investment in AI infrastructure, along with continued strength in traditional PC and commercial computing segments, as reasons for the more optimistic outlook.
segments.tr: Manajemen menunjuk pada investasi perusahaan yang berkelanjutan dalam infrastruktur AI, bersama dengan kekuatan yang terus berlanjut di segmen PC tradisional dan komputasi komersial, sebagai alasan untuk prospek yang lebih optimis tersebut.

segments.src: Raising guidance after a record quarter is often read by investors as a signal of confidence that current demand trends are durable rather than a one-time spike.
segments.tr: Meningkatkan panduan setelah kuartal yang memecahkan rekor sering kali dibaca oleh investor sebagai sinyal kepercayaan bahwa tren permintaan saat ini bersifat tahan lama, bukan lonjakan satu kali saja.

segments.src: For a hardware maker like Dell, whose margins depend heavily on the mix of AI-optimized servers versus traditional computing equipment, backlog growth of this magnitude offers a degree of revenue visibility that has been rare in the hardware industry.
segments.tr: Bagi pembuat perangkat keras seperti Dell, yang marginnya sangat bergantung pada campuran server yang dioptimalkan untuk AI dibandingkan peralatan komputasi tradisional, pertumbuhan backlog sebesar ini menawarkan tingkat visibilitas pendapatan yang jarang terjadi di industri perangkat keras.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Debate: Is the AI Buildout Overheating?
segments.tr: ## Perdebatan yang Lebih Besar: Apakah Pembangunan AI Mengalami Overheat?

segments.tr: Hasil Dell muncul di tengah perdebatan yang semakin intens di Wall Street dan Silicon Valley mengenai apakah pengeluaran perusahaan dan cloud untuk infrastruktur AI telah menjadi berlebihan.

segments.src: Proponents argue that the surge in orders reflects genuine, sustained demand for computing capacity as companies deploy AI models at scale across search, enterprise software, and consumer applications.
segments.tr: Para pendukung berpendapat bahwa lonjakan pesanan mencerminkan permintaan yang nyata dan berkelanjutan untuk kapasitas komputasi seiring perusahaan menerapkan model AI dalam skala besar di seluruh pencarian, perangkat lunak perusahaan, dan aplikasi konsumen.

segments.src: Skeptics, on the other hand, point to the enormous capital expenditure commitments being made across the technology sector and question whether returns on that investment will materialize quickly enough to justify current spending levels.
segments.tr: Di sisi lain, para skeptis menunjuk pada komitmen belanja modal yang sangat besar yang dilakukan di seluruh sektor teknologi dan mempertanyakan apakah pengembalian atas investasi tersebut akan terwujud cukup cepat untuk membenarkan tingkat pengeluaran saat ini.

segments.src: Some market watchers have drawn comparisons to prior technology infrastructure cycles, where rapid buildouts were later followed by periods of digestion once supply caught up with demand.
segments.tr: Beberapa pengamat pasar telah menarik perbandingan dengan siklus infrastruktur teknologi sebelumnya, di mana pembangunan cepat kemudian diikuti oleh periode pencernaan setelah pasokan mengejar permintaan.

segments.src: Dell's numbers do not resolve that debate, but they do offer fresh evidence that, for now, order volume from large buyers of AI infrastructure continues to climb rather than plateau.
segments.tr: Angka-angka Dell tidak menyelesaikan perdebatan itu, tetapi mereka menawarkan bukti baru bahwa, untuk saat ini, volume pesanan dari pembeli besar infrastruktur AI terus meningkat alih-alih mendatar.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward

segments.src: Meeting a $95 billion order pipeline requires securing enough AI accelerator chip supply, managing complex manufacturing logistics, and maintaining margins as competition among server makers intensifies.

segments.src: Investors will be watching upcoming quarters to see whether Dell can convert its backlog into delivered revenue at the pace implied by its raised guidance, and whether new orders continue to flow in at a similar clip.
segments.tr: Investor akan mengamati kuartal-kuartal mendatang untuk melihat apakah Dell dapat mengubah backlog-nya menjadi pendapatan yang dikirimkan dengan kecepatan yang tersirat oleh panduan yang ditingkatkan, dan apakah pesanan baru terus mengalir dengan kecepatan yang sama.

segments.src: The results also serve as a broader data point for the technology sector: as long as large AI buyers keep placing orders, hardware suppliers further down the chain stand to benefit — at least until spending patterns shift.
segments.tr: Hasil ini juga berfungsi sebagai titik data yang lebih luas untuk sektor teknologi: selama pembeli AI besar terus melakukan pemesanan, pemasok perangkat keras lebih jauh di rantai pasokan akan diuntungkan — setidaknya sampai pola pengeluaran berubah.

segments.src: Proponents argue that the surge in orders reflects genuine, sustained demand for computing capacity as companies deploy AI models at scale across search, enterprise software, and consumer applications.

segments.src: Dell's numbers do not resolve that debate, but they do offer fresh evidence that, for now, order volume from large buyers of AI infrastructure continues to climb rather than plateau.

segments.tr: Die Rallye steigerte den Marktwert von Dell um Milliarden von Dollar und entfachte den Enthusiasmus der Anleger für Unternehmen neu, die im Zentrum des Aufbaus der KI-Infrastruktur stehen.

segments.src: At the heart of the announcement was a striking figure: a record $95 billion backlog of AI server orders still waiting to be fulfilled.
segments.tr: Im Mittelpunkt der Ankündigung stand eine markante Zahl: ein Rekordauftragsbestand an KI-Servern im Wert von 95 Milliarden Dollar, der noch auf seine Erfüllung wartet.

segments.src: That number represents work already booked but not yet delivered or recognized as revenue, giving investors a rare window into how much demand is queued up for the coming quarters.
segments.tr: Diese Zahl stellt Arbeit dar, die bereits gebucht, aber noch nicht geliefert oder als Umsatz verbucht wurde, und gibt Anlegern ein seltenes Fenster, um zu sehen, wie viel Nachfrage für die kommenden Quartale in der Warteschlange steht.

segments.src: ## What Drove the Beat
segments.tr: ## Was den Erfolg antrieb

segments.src: Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group, which houses its server and networking business, has become the company's primary growth engine over the past two years as enterprises and cloud providers race to build out AI computing capacity.
segments.tr: Dells Infrastructure Solutions Group, in der das Server- und Netzwerkgeschäft gebündelt ist, hat sich in den letzten zwei Jahren zum primären Wachstumsmotor des Unternehmens entwickelt, da Unternehmen und Cloud-Anbieter darum wetteifern, KI-Rechenkapazitäten aufzubauen.

segments.src: Large customers — including hyperscale cloud operators and enterprise clients building private AI clusters — have been placing increasingly large orders for servers equipped with the latest generation of AI accelerator chips.
segments.tr: Große Kunden – darunter Hyperscale-Cloud-Betreiber und Unternehmenskunden, die private KI-Cluster aufbauen – haben zunehmend große Bestellungen für Server aufgegeben, die mit der neuesten Generation von KI-Beschleunigerchips ausgestattet sind.

segments.src: The scale of the backlog suggests that demand is not just holding steady but continuing to accelerate, even as the AI infrastructure buildout enters its third year.
segments.tr: Das Ausmaß des Auftragsbestands deutet darauf hin, dass die Nachfrage nicht nur stabil bleibt, sondern weiter beschleunigt wird, selbst während der Aufbau der KI-Infrastruktur in sein drittes Jahr geht.

segments.src: Analysts have noted that order backlogs of this size typically indicate visibility into future revenue that extends well beyond a single quarter, giving management more confidence in forward guidance.
segments.tr: Analysten haben angemerkt, dass Auftragsbestände dieser Größe typischerweise Einblick in zukünftige Umsätze gewähren, die weit über ein einzelnes Quartal hinausgehen, was dem Management mehr Vertrauen in die Prognosen gibt.

segments.src: ## Guidance Raised for the Full Year
segments.tr: ## Prognose für das Gesamtjahr angehoben

segments.src: Following the strong results, Dell raised its full-year sales guidance to $192 billion, up from prior projections.
segments.tr: Nach den starken Ergebnissen hob Dell seine Umsatzprognose für das Gesamtjahr auf 192 Milliarden US-Dollar an, gegenüber vorherigen Schätzungen.

segments.src: Management pointed to sustained enterprise investment in AI infrastructure, along with continued strength in traditional PC and commercial computing segments, as reasons for the more optimistic outlook.
segments.tr: Das Management verwies auf anhaltende Unternehmensinvestitionen in die KI-Infrastruktur sowie auf die anhaltende Stärke in den traditionellen PC- und kommerziellen Computersegmenten als Gründe für den optimistischeren Ausblick.

segments.src: Raising guidance after a record quarter is often read by investors as a signal of confidence that current demand trends are durable rather than a one-time spike.
segments.tr: Das Anheben der Prognose nach einem Rekordquartal wird von Anlegern oft als Signal des Vertrauens gewertet, dass die aktuellen Nachfragetrends nachhaltig und kein einmaliger Ausschlag sind.

segments.src: For a hardware maker like Dell, whose margins depend heavily on the mix of AI-optimized servers versus traditional computing equipment, backlog growth of this magnitude offers a degree of revenue visibility that has been rare in the hardware industry.
segments.tr: Für einen Hardware-Hersteller wie Dell, dessen Margen stark von der Mischung aus KI-optimierten Servern im Vergleich zu traditionellen Computergeräten abhängen, bietet ein Auftragsbestandszuwachs dieser Größenordnung ein Maß an Umsatzeintransparenz, das in der Hardware-Industrie selten ist.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Debate: Is the AI Buildout Overheating?
segments.tr: ## Die größere Debatte: Überhitzt der KI-Aufbau?

segments.src: Dell's results landed in the middle of an intensifying debate on Wall Street and in Silicon Valley about whether corporate and cloud spending on AI infrastructure has become excessive.
segments.tr: Die Ergebnisse von Dell trafen mitten in eine sich verschärfende Debatte an der Wall Street und im Silicon Valley darüber, ob die Unternehmens- und Cloud-Ausgaben für KI-Infrastruktur übermäßig geworden sind.

segments.src: Proponents argue that the surge in orders reflects genuine, sustained demand for computing capacity as companies deploy AI models at scale across search, enterprise software, and consumer applications.
segments.tr: Befürworter argumentieren, dass der Anstieg der Bestellungen eine echte, anhaltende Nachfrage nach Rechenkapazität widerspiegelt, während Unternehmen KI-Modelle in großem Maßstab in den Bereichen Suche, Unternehmenssoftware und Verbraucheranwendungen einsetzen.

segments.src: Skeptics, on the other hand, point to the enormous capital expenditure commitments being made across the technology sector and question whether returns on that investment will materialize quickly enough to justify current spending levels.
segments.tr: Skeptiker hingegen verweisen auf die enormen Investitionsverpflichtungen, die im gesamten Technologiesektor eingegangen werden, und stellen die Frage, ob die Renditen dieser Investitionen schnell genug eintreten werden, um das aktuelle Ausgabenniveau zu rechtfertigen.

segments.src: Some market watchers have drawn comparisons to prior technology infrastructure cycles, where rapid buildouts were later followed by periods of digestion once supply caught up with demand.
segments.tr: Einige Marktbeobachter haben Vergleiche zu früheren Technologie-Infrastrukturzyklen gezogen, bei denen auf rasche Aufbauphasen später Perioden der Verdauung folgten, sobald das Angebot die Nachfrage einholte.

segments.src: Dell's numbers do not resolve that debate, but they do offer fresh evidence that, for now, order volume from large buyers of AI infrastructure continues to climb rather than plateau.
segments.tr: Dells Zahlen lösen diese Debatte nicht, aber sie bieten neue Beweise dafür, dass das Bestellvolumen von Großkäufern von KI-Infrastruktur vorerst weiter steigt, anstatt zu stagnieren.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## Was das für die Zukunft bedeutet

segments.src: For Dell, the record backlog provides a cushion of future revenue, but it also raises the bar for execution.
segments.tr: Für Dell bietet der Rekordauftragsbestand ein Polster für zukünftige Umsätze, erhöht jedoch auch die Messlatte für die Ausführung.

segments.src: Meeting a $95 billion order pipeline requires securing enough AI accelerator chip supply, managing complex manufacturing logistics, and maintaining margins as competition among server makers intensifies.
segments.tr: Die Erfüllung einer Auftrags-Pipeline im Wert von 95 Milliarden US-Dollar erfordert die Sicherstellung einer ausreichenden Versorgung mit KI-Beschleunigerchips, die Verwaltung komplexer Fertigungslogistik und die Aufrechterhaltung der Margen, da der Wettbewerb unter Serverherstellern zunimmt.

segments.src: Investors will be watching upcoming quarters to see whether Dell can convert its backlog into delivered revenue at the pace implied by its raised guidance, and whether new orders continue to flow in at a similar clip.
segments.tr: Anleger werden die kommenden Quartale beobachten, um zu sehen, ob Dell seinen Auftragsbestand in dem von seiner angehobenen Prognose implizierten Tempo in gelieferte Umsätze umwandeln kann und ob neue Aufträge weiterhin in ähnlichem Tempo eingehen.

segments.src: The results also serve as a broader data point for the technology sector: as long as large AI buyers keep placing orders, hardware suppliers further down the chain stand to benefit — at least until spending patterns shift.
segments.tr: Die Ergebnisse dienen auch als breiterer Datenpunkt für den Technologiesektor: Solange große KI-Käufer weiterhin Bestellungen aufgeben, können Hardware-Lieferanten weiter unten in der Kette davon profitieren – zumindest bis sich die Ausgabenmuster ändern.

segments.src: ## Dell Stock Surges on Record AI Server Demand
segments.tr: ## Cổ phiếu Dell tăng vọt nhờ nhu cầu máy chủ AI đạt kỷ lục

segments.tr: Cổ phiếu của Dell Technologies đã tăng tới 16% trong một phiên giao dịch duy nhất sau khi công ty báo cáo kết quả kinh doanh quý vượt kỳ vọng của Wall Street, được thúc đẩy gần như hoàn toàn bởi nhu cầu bùng nổ đối với các máy chủ được xây dựng để xử lý khối lượng công việc trí tuệ nhân tạo.

segments.tr: Đợt tăng giá này đã bổ sung hàng tỷ đô la vào giá trị thị trường của Dell và thắp lại sự nhiệt huyết của các nhà đầu tư đối với các công ty nằm ở trung tâm của quá trình xây dựng hạ tầng AI.

segments.tr: Trọng tâm của thông báo là một con số ấn tượng: lượng đơn đặt hàng máy chủ AI tồn đọng đạt kỷ lục $95 tỷ vẫn đang chờ được thực hiện.

segments.tr: Con số đó đại diện cho công việc đã được đặt hàng nhưng chưa được giao hoặc chưa được ghi nhận là doanh thu, mang lại cho các nhà đầu tư một góc nhìn hiếm hoi về mức độ nhu cầu đang xếp hàng cho các quý tới.

segments.tr: ## Yếu tố thúc đẩy sự vượt kỳ vọng

segments.tr: Nhóm Giải pháp Hạ tầng (Infrastructure Solutions Group) của Dell, nơi chứa mảng kinh doanh máy chủ và mạng, đã trở thành động cơ tăng trưởng chính của công ty trong hai năm qua khi các doanh nghiệp và nhà cung cấp dịch vụ đám mây đua nhau xây dựng năng lực tính toán AI.

segments.tr: Các khách hàng lớn — bao gồm các nhà khai thác đám mây quy mô siêu lớn (hyperscale) và các khách hàng doanh nghiệp xây dựng các cụm AI riêng — đã và đang đặt các đơn hàng ngày càng lớn cho các máy chủ được trang bị thế hệ chip tăng tốc AI mới nhất.

segments.tr: Quy mô của lượng đơn hàng tồn đọng cho thấy nhu cầu không chỉ giữ ở mức ổn định mà còn tiếp tục tăng tốc, ngay cả khi quá trình xây dựng hạ tầng AI bước sang năm thứ ba.

segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích đã lưu ý rằng lượng đơn hàng tồn đọng ở quy mô này thường cho thấy tầm nhìn rõ ràng về doanh thu trong tương lai kéo dài vượt xa một quý đơn lẻ, giúp ban quản lý tự tin hơn vào dự báo tương lai.
